author: GamingBolt
description:
Over the last couple of weeks, we covered the entire history of the Gears of War franchise, starting with Gears of War Judgmentt and concluding with the end of the trilogy in Gears of War 3.
 
Now, we are back with the complete compilation of all those stories along with new additions in the form of recaps for Gears of War 4, Gears 5, and Hivebusters, making this recap one of the most comprehensive available. So, in this video, we will cover the following games part by part: Gears of War Judgment, Gears Tactics, Gears of War 1, Gears of War 2, Gears of War 3, Gears of War 4 and Gears 5, including all of their important DLCs.
title: Gears of War: The Complete Story - The Definitive Recap Before Gears of War: E-Day

author: GamingBolt
description:
Gears of War: E-Day is inching ever closer to its final release, and we’ve sunk some time into Kalona City to see how it manages to present an experience that either surpasses what’s come before it or, at the very least, meets those standards. 

Fortunately, it’s the former; this title is a step into the future for a franchise already at the forefront of games with great visuals and excellent presentation. We split our time between the Xbox Series X and a fairly powerful PC, and if you’re wondering how well this game performs before picking it up, this comparison will make you very happy indeed.
title: Gears of War: E-Day Is One of the Best Looking Games of this Generation: Xbox vs PC Comparison

author: GamingBolt
description:
Gears of War: E-Day delivers all the things you would want first and foremost from a Gears experience in spades- blood, guts, explosions, and high-octane action. Its storytelling and writing can feel a bit inconsistent, but even so, it manages to deliver one of the series’ best-paced and most enjoyable campaigns in years. 

New movement mechanics and excellent encounter design in particular help the series’ excellent fundamental combat mechanics shine brighter than ever, while Kalona also serves as a great semi-open world-slash-wide linear setting, even if its optional content offerings aren’t always up to the mark. All said and done, Gears of War: E-Day is an excellent new outing for the series, and one of its stronger entries in many years.
title: Gears of War E-Day Review - The Final Verdict
